explication: openpilot is a robotics operating system providing driver assistance for supported cars. The principal workflow is: cameras and vehicle sensors produce observations; model, localization, planning, and control processes compute driving commands; panda communicates those commands to the car; the UI presents state and alerts. The manager initializes parameters, registers the device, and supervises runtime processes. Logging, upload, networking, remote routes, replay, and CAN-analysis tools are additional product capabilities. Several process internals were not sampled, so only documented or directly evidenced wiring is shown.
